message: Maintenance completed. We are monitoring service health.

The slowdown is caused by increased load on the identity service. We are scaling capacity.

A queue backlog is delaying webhook delivery. Additional workers are being added.

A bad deploy is the cause. Rollback is in progress.

API error rates are back to normal. The incident is resolved.
